proof_body:
by
  intro R _ f g hf hg h1 h2
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with h | h
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · have hd : g.natDegree ≤ f.natDegree := by
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h2
      have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        exact hf.ne_zero (mul_zero g)
      rw [hg.natDegree_mul' hc]
      exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
    exact (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hf hg h1 hd).symm
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (f g : Polynomial R), f.Monic → g.Monic → f ∣ g → g ∣ f → f = g
